tool.name: google_play_reviews_search
tool.title: Google Play App Reviews Search
tool.description:
Extract public Google Play Store reviews for one or more Android apps, including star rating, review text, reviewer name, developer replies, and app-level metadata (rating breakdown, installs, category, developer).

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/google-play-reviews-scraper'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; does not modify any Google Play account, app listing, or review.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 15-45 seconds per app; timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for app-store sentiment research, competitor review monitoring, feature/complaint mining, or tracking developer response rates across one or more Android apps.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for iOS App Store reviews, general web search, or employment/job data.
- Named alternatives: Use 'linkedin_jobs_search' for hiring/job listings or 'youtube_video_search' for video content discovery; neither covers app-store review data.

app_ids.description: Android package IDs or full Google Play app URLs to pull reviews for, up to 25 (e.g. ['com.spotify.music', 'com.google.android.youtube']).

max_results.description: Maximum number of review records to return per app. Defaults to 25.

scores.description: Optional star-rating filter (1-5). Keep only reviews matching any of these ratings, e.g. [1, 2] for negative reviews. Omit to return all ratings.

keywords.description: Optional list of words or phrases; keep only reviews whose text contains any of them (case-insensitive). Omit to skip this filter.

recent_days.description: Optional recency filter: keep only reviews posted within this many days of now (e.g. 30). Omit to return reviews of any age.

results.description: Collection of Google Play review records extracted for the requested app(s).

app_id.description: Android package identifier for the reviewed app.

app_title.description: Display name of the reviewed app on Google Play.

score.description: Integer star rating from one to five.

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was posted.

thumbs_up.description: Number of users who marked the review helpful.

developer_reply.description: Public developer response text when present.

scores.note: Actor's input schema declares scores items as an enum of strings '1'..'5', not integers; each value must be str()'d before sending.

verification.notes: POSTed {"app_ids": ["com.spotify.music"], "max_items": 3} to captainhandsome~google-play-reviews-scraper/runs (build=latest, timeout=120), polled to SUCCEEDED, fetched 3 dataset items; app_id field 'com.spotify.music' contains the relevance token 'spotify' in every row.
